title: Beef Hash Masala
description: A flavorful twist on traditional hash, this dish combines tender beef and crispy potatoes with Indian spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the hash to the skillet and stir to combine with the beef and onion mixture.
Sprinkle the cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper over the top of the hash and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
